ema_strategy._lengths_note: Lengths are always 8/13/21/55 in BARS at the active chart interval (SIGNAL_INTERVAL): 55 bars = 55 half-hours on a 30m chart, 55 days on a 1d chart. Lengths never change; only the bar interval does. Smoothing: the three slow lines (13/21/55) are TEMA (triple EMA) and the 8 is a plain EMA — matching the TradingView chart the strategy is read from ('TEMA 13 21 55' + 'EMA 8'). A plain-EMA 55 line lags far behind the chart and reads BUY long after the chart reads SELL.
ema_strategy.buy_signal: red TEMA(55) crosses below ALL of EMA(8)/TEMA(13)/TEMA(21) — becomes lowest line
ema_strategy.sell_signal: red TEMA(55) crosses above ALL of EMA(8)/TEMA(13)/TEMA(21) — becomes highest line. For a HELD position, SELL state itself (red on top) triggers the sell even if the cross happened on an earlier bar (no fresh EXIT transition required).
ema_strategy.hold_rule: when red TEMA(55) is above all 3 — do nothing, stock is downtrending
ema_strategy.wait_rule: when red TEMA(55) is below all 3 — hold position

learned_rules.rule: Enforce the confidence-band floor as a hard pre-trade gate: never open a position with confidence_score < 60, empty thesis, or empty sources_used.
learned_rules.rationale: T0002 (CAT) was opened at confidence 55 with empty thesis and sources — a direct violation of the existing 'below 60 → skip' band floor. The floor existed in strategy but was not enforced at execution time. Applied to skill_2_execution as a hard pre-buy gate. This is enforcement of an existing rule, not a new core rule, so the 3+ outcome bar does not apply.

learned_rules.rule: Post-extension / post-catalyst entry filter: do not open a new position in an already-extended name (up >10% on the entry day, OR up >25% over the trailing ~10 sessions, OR within 5 sessions of an earnings/catalyst spike-and-fade) UNLESS a fresh red(55) ENTER_LONG crossover prints with clear ribbon separation. A stale HOLD or bare 'price above all 4 EMAs' read does not qualify. The widest EMA spread in the universe is an over-extension warning that caps confidence, never a buy confirmation. Wait for a pullback to the ribbon or a fresh cross.
learned_rules.rationale: Three independent breakeven/loss round-trips all share the same root cause — chasing an already-extended move. T0002 (CAT) bought post-spike chop (+4.33% Jun 2 / -3.68% Jun 5). T0004 (CLOV) bought the closing print of a +14% catalyst day at +98% YTD, with the 'widest EMA spread in universe (14.8%)' misread as strength when it was max over-extension. T0006 (AI) bought a post-earnings spike-and-fade within 5 sessions of the Jun 3 print on a stale 'above all EMAs' read. This meets the 3+ similar-outcome bar, so P001's one-confirmation-bar intent is generalized and applied to skill_2_execution's pre-buy gate (an execution entry filter, not a change to the core red(55) buy/sell definition). source_weights unchanged — the failures were entry-location, not source, errors.

proposals_pending_confirmation.proposal: For names that moved >3% in any of the prior 3 sessions, require the EMA buy signal to persist for one confirmation bar before entry (anti-whipsaw filter).
proposals_pending_confirmation.rationale: Originally proposed on T0002 alone. With T0004 and T0006 adding two more chased-extension round-trips, the 3+ bar is met. Rather than apply the narrow one-confirmation-bar mechanic verbatim, the intent is generalized into LR002 (post-extension/post-catalyst entry filter) as an execution-layer gate. Marked resolved.

proposals_pending_confirmation.proposal: Exit-price integrity: sanity-check every recorded exit_price against the broker's last/quote at exit time, and capture exit_price from the actual broker sell-fill average price for EMA/forced exits — never default it to entry_price. If a close's exit_price equals entry_price exactly (or deviates >2% from the broker quote), do not book it; flag for reconciliation.
proposals_pending_confirmation.rationale: T0003 (HOOD), T0004 (CLOV) and T0006 (AI) all booked exit_price == entry_price to the penny while the broker market was materially higher (HOOD ~$93 vs the $89.01 exit). This is a HIGH-priority data-integrity defect in agent.py's exit path (exit price appears to default to entry price rather than read the broker fill), which silently caps all upside on winning theses. It cannot be fixed from a skill file or strategy.json — it requires a code change to the EMA/forced-exit booking logic. Flagged, not applied. Until fixed, do NOT treat these three flat closes as confidence-calibration evidence (see confidence_accuracy notes).

proposals_pending_confirmation.proposal: Require ≥2 independent sources in agreement before any new entry clears 60 confidence; single-source theses cap at 59 (skip). Additionally hard-cap below 60 any candidate whose most recent reported quarter shows YoY revenue decline >25%.
proposals_pending_confirmation.rationale: T0006 (AI) was a single-source (fundamental-only) 62-confidence entry on a name with ~52% YoY revenue decline and -21% YTD. Plausible, but only one clean case so far (HUM/T0007 is the other single-source name but closed at breakeven, not a clear loss). Core confidence-gating change — needs 3+ similar single-source / declining-revenue losses before applying. Re-evaluate when another single-source loss prints.
